# Legal support improvement contract

## Hypothesis

The v1.1 legal-support prompt can remove instructions already enforced by matter, reference-data, access and minimum-data pre-checks while preserving all six outcomes and reducing prompt context.

## Evidence generated by this POC

- Expected and observed state for normal matter opening, safe replay, reference exception, timeout recovery, restricted access and general IT.
- Stable intake-ID, lookup-before-retry, information-barrier, data-minimisation and named-approval controls.
- Rejected approval overrides for unmapped reference data and restricted matter access.
- Provider calls made and avoided, prompt characters, local token proxy and actual local model spend.
- Active and candidate versions, actor, decision and rollback path.

## Activation and rollback

The runner can recommend v1.1 but cannot activate it. A named legal-technology support owner approves activation. Rejection keeps v1.0. Reset returns the runtime to v1.0 for the demonstration.

## Stop criteria

- A restricted or unmapped case reaches the provider.
- A matter is duplicated or an ambiguous create is blindly retried.
- An information-barrier, reference-data or named-approval boundary regresses.
- Privileged or unnecessary matter content, credentials or personal data are requested or exposed.
- An unauthorised action or uncontrolled cost occurs.
- A rule, knowledge article or conventional automation is more reliable or economical.
